clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. EO 8926 (Franklin D. Roosevelt, October 28, 1941), held Federal Register text, section 5: "5. Executive Order No. 8751 of May 2, 1941, establishing the Division of Defense Aid Reports and defining its functions and duties, is hereby revoked." The sentence states no later effective date and EO 8926 states none for its other sections, so the signing date October 28, 1941 is the end date. Section 1, which creates the Division and its head, ends with the Division it establishes.

The sentence states no later effective date and EO 8926 states none for its other sections, so the signing date October 28, 1941 is the end date. Section 2, which lists the Division's duties (items a to d), ends with the Division it assigns them to.

Terminated by express revocation. EO 8926 (Franklin D. Roosevelt, October 28, 1941), held Federal Register text, section 5: "5. Executive Order No. 8751 of May 2, 1941, establishing the Division of Defense Aid Reports and defining its functions and duties, is hereby revoked." The sentence states no later effective date and EO 8926 states none for its other sections, so the signing date October 28, 1941 is the end date. Section 3, which supplies funds, personnel and services to the Division, ends with the Division it serves.

research_rationale:
EO 8751 (May 2, 1941, Franklin D. Roosevelt), read in full in the held Federal Register text (one order, three numbered sections), establishes the Division of Defense Aid Reports under an Executive Officer (section 1), lists its duties (section 2, items a to d) and provides funds, personnel and services (section 3). EO 8926 (October 28, 1941), held Federal Register text, revokes it by number in section 5. The order has no stated term, so the first end is that express revocation.

savings.reason: EO 8926 has five sections and none of them preserves any command of EO 8751: section 1 creates an Office of Lend-Lease Administration, section 2 gives its Administrator authority under the Act of March 11, 1941, section 3 requires clearance with the Economic Defense Board, section 4 provides staff and facilities, and section 5 revokes EO 8751. Whether personnel, records or funds of the Division passed to the new Office is not stated in the held text, and no other held source shows it; that is a disclosed qualification, not a finding.
